thread:
lia: Heads up — canary deploy to eu-west hit a bunch of failed jobs, looks like runner disk saturation + cache restore timeouts.
omar: saw that, failing step is `integration-tests` after `restore-cache`. logs attached from runner-42.
ci-bot: Job 5821: cache restore 1/3 failed (timeout 120s), fallback hit, then artifact verify mismatch on extracted wheel.
kyle: can you paste the tail of the runner log? especially the entries around `tar: unexpected EOF` or `no space left on device`.
omar: paste: ```
2026-03-21T09:18:31Z runner-42: ERROR: tar: unexpected EOF
2026-03-21T09:18:32Z runner-42: WARNING: loop: image-extract failed, cleaning /tmp/extract-XXXX
2026-03-21T09:18:33Z runner-42: ERROR: write /tmp/extract-XXXX/foo.whl: no space left on device
```
lia: that matches intermittent disk eviction on ephemeral runners — we've seen this when parallel restores spike.
release-manager: timeline? is canary completely blocked or some instances passed?
omar: 2/8 canary nodes passed earlier; the failing ones are all in the same autoscaled runner pool. failing job causes deploybot to hold promotion.
kyle: possible mitigation: 1) reduce parallelism of cache restores 2) pin to last-good image to unblock promotion 3) re-run canary with runner pool drain+reprovision.
lia: preference is (2) + (3) short term. pinning avoids a rollback and keeps roll forward safe.
release-manager: what does pin look like here? tag and promote previous commit? manual override on deploybot?
omar: deploybot supports `promo pin <image-digest>` from the release queue. we have last-good image digest: sha256:7f3a9b..
lia: I'll kick off pin and a repro run on a fresh runner pool to validate. if repro still flakes, we'll roll back.
ci-bot: Action taken: queued `promo pin sha256:7f3a9b..` by lia at 09:22Z.
omar: also created a short-lived mitigation: lowered `CI_CACHE_RESTORE_PARALLELISM=2` for the canary pipeline (temp env override).
kyle: add to release notes: "Canary promoted from previous image due to ephemeral runner storage saturation causing cache restore corruption; root cause under investigation."
release-manager: agree. also notify infra to check autoscaler image for runner-42 pool — might need larger ephemeral storage or different tmpfs settings.
lia: infra ticket created: INFRA-1182 (ephemeral-runner: investigate disk saturation/cleanup cadence). tagging @infra.
omar: re-run started on fresh pool at 09:25Z. I'll monitor jobs and post status.
ci-bot: Job 5826: integration-tests started on runner-61 (fresh).
omar: green on 6/8 after repro, two still in flight (these use 3rd-party snapshot mirrors).
kyle: if those two time out, we pin and unblock. don't do a rollback unless we see artifact checksum mismatches on the pinned candidate.
lia: update: both finished green at 09:34Z. canary looks healthy.
release-manager: decision: manual promote to prod allowed. record: pinned briefly while infra remediation proceeds, but we promoted previous digest once green. no rollback required.
omar: I'll leave a follow-up patch to add a temporary safety gate: limit cache restore concurrency for pipelines that run on ephemeral runners. PR in ci-config coming from me.
lia: thanks — will remove the promo pin if infra's fix lands. adding postmortem note to the release thread. :memo:
release-manager: great. closing the hold. final action items: INFRA-1182 owner, MAR-PR-772 (ci-config throttle), and release notes entry.
kyle: thanks team :thumbsup:
